description: This Java class 'DefaultMongoDbConfig' provides the default implementation of the 'MongoDbConfig' interface, encapsulating MongoDB configuration parameters such as URI, query time, connection pool, circuit breaker, and monitoring settings. It includes methods for instantiation from a configuration object, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultMongoDbConfig
classes.description: Implementation of MongoDbConfig interface, holding MongoDB configuration details.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultMongoDbConfig from a Config object, applying fallback values and determining the MongoDB URI.

methods.name: getMaxQueryTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum query time duration for MongoDB operations.

methods.name: getOptionsConfig
methods.description: Returns the options configuration for MongoDB.
